question: Should the agent activity timeline be built as a CLI/chat/TUI surface over the shared metadata-audit and subagent lifecycle foundations, or should this issue stay separate with its own timeline storage/API contract?
rationale: Current source has several partial signals, but the permanent owner boundary, storage model, redaction rules, retention, and UI/export scope require maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Build on audit foundation first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata owner and add the timeline UI/CLI/TUI surfaces only after that contract is settled.

options.title: Create a dedicated timeline contract
options.body: Define a separate agent-activity table/API for this issue now, accepting the risk of a parallel audit source of truth.

options.title: Limit to ephemeral UI
options.body: Keep durable export out of scope and extend only the existing browser-local Activity or TUI surfaces for live observation.

recommendation.title: Build on audit foundation first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata owner and add the timeline UI/CLI/TUI surfaces only after that contract is settled.
